scoring_justification: The artifact is the final deterministic pattern; we compare the whitespace-normalized string to the paper's reported pattern. Recompute from base vectors is not performed in the checker to keep it lightweight, but exact string match after normalization is sufficient for verification.

hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The gold pattern is the precise result reported in the paper; it is a fixed mathematical expression with no degrees of freedom.

schema.description: Single-line text representing the displacement pattern of the Cmm2 bush with four parameters A,B,C,D. The pattern must be in the form (A,B|2C,-C|2D,-D|-A,A+B|A,-A-B|-2D,D|-2C,C|-A,-B).

outputs.description: The full displacement pattern string for the four-dimensional bush B[Cmm2]; scored by exact match against the paper's reported pattern after whitespace normalization.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker normalises whitespace and compares the agent's output character-by-character to the gold pattern. No tolerance band is used because the target is a fixed deterministic symbolic expression.
